topics.name: Market Correction vs Crisis Framework
topics.summary: Coatue's deck analyzed historical crises (dot-com, GFC, COVID) vs. corrections using drawdown magnitude, earnings cuts, VIX duration, and recovery time; argued 2025 tariff selloff looks more like a correction than a crisis, with earnings only 5% off highs.

topics.name: Nvidia Earnings Q1 FY2026
topics.summary: Nvidia posted record $44B revenue (+69% YoY) despite $2.5B in blocked H20 China shipments; projected $8B in lost China revenue next quarter; stock up 5% after hours; surpassed Meta in quarterly revenue.

topics.name: AI Training vs Inference Shift
topics.summary: Debate over whether inference is growing as a share of GPU workloads; Nvidia reports 40% inference and 60% training, unchanged from last quarter; Jensen and Collette Kress cited step-function demand growth in reasoning AI tokens.

topics.name: NVLink Fusion Platform
topics.summary: Nvidia announced it will allow customers to combine rival CPUs and accelerators with Nvidia's high-speed interconnect and CUDA software, opening the ecosystem while maintaining software lock-in.

topics.name: Tokens vs Tariffs
topics.summary: Coatue's central thesis that AI token growth and the AI infrastructure boom are more economically significant than the tariff-driven macro disruption.

topics.name: US Debt and Bond Market Alarm
topics.summary: Jamie Dimon, Ray Dalio, and Paul Tudor Jones cited as warning of unsustainable US debt; the One Big Beautiful Bill could add $3-5T to debt; federal interest payments now exceed defense budget and Medicaid combined.

topics.name: Nike D2C Pivot Failure
topics.summary: Nike's 6-year experiment going direct-to-consumer failed: revenue fell 9%, brand marketing was neglected, wholesale was deprioritized, and the company is now returning to Amazon and wholesale channels.

topics.name: Gulf AI Deals and Geopolitics
topics.summary: Trump administration's Middle East AI tour resulted in GPU deals with UAE and Saudi Arabia framed as economic statecraft requiring reciprocal US investment and security guarantees; security conditions still being finalized.

topics.name: US AI Export Controls and China Strategy
topics.summary: Debate over whether restricting GPU exports to China strengthens Huawei, with Aaron Ginn and Jensen Huang arguing America should flood the world with its AI stack to prevent dependency on Chinese platforms.

topics.name: Ukraine Drone Attack on Russian Bombers
topics.summary: Ukraine conducted a sophisticated drone strike on Russian strategic bombers; Doug Philippone called it a major tactical victory with strategic consequences for Russian bomber dispersal, but uncertain impact on war outcome.

topics.name: Vibecession Persists in 2025
topics.summary: Consumer sentiment is at 25-year lows across investors, businesses, and consumers, yet hard data like Visa, Amex, Capital One, and Bank of America spend data shows consumers are still spending normally.

topics.name: Hyperscaler CapEx Surge
topics.summary: Combined CapEx of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, Oracle, and Tesla has risen from $213B to $365B, a 70%+ jump, driven by real inference demand; cited as evidence AI spending is demand-driven.

topics.name: Open Source AI as Geopolitical Tool
topics.summary: Divyansh Kaushik argued the US should flood developing nations with American open source AI to prevent dependency on Chinese models like DeepSeek, which may contain state-embedded vulnerabilities.

topics.name: Defense Tech Modernization
topics.summary: Doug Philippone discussed how Palantir's decade-long lawsuit established commercial software preference in DoD procurement, opening the door for modern defense tech startups; executive orders on acquisition reform now accelerating this.

topics.name: Humanoid Robotics Sim-to-Real Gap
topics.summary: SemiAnalysis highlighted ASAP research showing how Tesla Optimus and Unitree G1 robots use simulated training and delta correction models to achieve fluid human-like motion, addressing the sim-to-real transfer problem.

topics.name: D2C Value Chain and Facebook's Dominance
topics.summary: Ben Thompson's analysis showed D2C brands failed because they outsourced marketing to Facebook and Google, which captured all the profits through rising customer acquisition costs.

topics.name: Nuclear Energy for AI Data Centers
topics.summary: Meta and Constellation Energy announced a 20-year nuclear power deal for the Clinton Clean Energy Center; Aaron Ginn was skeptical about broad nuclear adoption for data centers due to regulatory and political hurdles.

topics.name: IPO Window Opening
topics.summary: Chime launched its IPO roadshow at a $9.1B valuation vs. a $25B VC-era peak; seen as a signal that private companies are accepting down rounds to access public markets as the window reopens.

topics.name: Perplexity as Default Search
topics.summary: Perplexity reportedly in talks with Apple and Samsung for default search placement on iPhone and Android; also launched agentic travel booking features.

key_claims: Coatue's Hard Truth Index shows sentiment at -1.4 vs. hard economic data at -0.3, the largest dislocation in 25 years of tracking
Nvidia Q1 revenue was $44B, up 69% YoY, surpassing Meta in quarterly revenue for the first time
Nvidia was unable to ship $2.5B in H20 chips and projects $8B in lost revenue next quarter due to China export controls
Microsoft processed over 100 trillion tokens in Q1 2025, a 5x year-over-year increase, including 50 trillion in the last month alone
OpenAI grew from 400M to 800M monthly active users in a matter of weeks according to Sam Altman
70% of Fortune 500 companies are using Microsoft Copilot for AI tasks
Combined hyperscaler CapEx (Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, Oracle, Tesla) has risen from $213B to $365B, a forecast 70%+ increase
Nvidia had 95% market share in China four years ago; it is now only 50% per Jensen Huang
40% of Nvidia chips are used for inference and 60% for training, unchanged from last quarter
The 2025 NASDAQ had its worst start through April 21st ever, with an 18% drawdown, worse than 2022's 16% and the dot-com era's 12%
Polymarket US recession probability peaked at 66% post-Liberation Day tariffs, fell to 30% by show date
Anthropic grew annualized revenue from $1B to $3B in five months
The One Big Beautiful Bill could add $3T to US debt over the next decade, or $5T if temporary provisions are made permanent
Federal interest payments in FY2025 will exceed both the defense budget and Medicaid/disability/food stamps combined
Ray Dalio gives America 3 years, plus or minus one, to avert an economic heart attack
Jensen Huang stated Nvidia lost 50% China market share over four years due to export controls accelerating Huawei's development
Ukraine is producing approximately 400,000 FPV drones per month; China claims capacity of 500,000 per month
China's Huawei Ascend chips have approximately 20% manufacturing yield rates, making them extremely costly without state subsidies
The January 2025 Biden AI diffusion rules made two critical errors: underestimating Huawei's timeline (assumed 5 years, was ~12 months) and assuming LLMs are primarily accessed remotely
OpenEvidence reportedly raising $100M at a $3B valuation, up from $1B just months earlier
Tombravo raised over $34B in new buyout funds, with $1.8B earmarked for European software companies
